text:
Okay, listen! You have to come here with me. It’s like a giant, secret magic spell outside. The fog is so thick it eats the streetlights, you know? Like, *poof*, they’re just fuzzy yellow blobs floating in milk. And it’s freezing! Not just cold-cold, but bone-chilly cold. My toes are numb and my nose feels like an icicle trying to fall off.

But look at the station! It’s all quiet and rusty and old. No trains, no people, nothing. Just us and the shadows. The bench is covered in frost that sparkles like glitter when I touch it, and it burns my fingers a little bit. It smells like wet iron and snow. Isn’t it spooky-cool? Like we’re the only two kids left in the whole world, waiting for a ghost train to take us somewhere far away. Do you hear that tiny squeak? Maybe it’s the wind, or maybe… maybe it’s watching us. Let’s stay right here for one more minute, okay?
